test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: A bottle with the cost price of Rs. 4500 is marked x% above the cost price and sold after two successive discount of Rs. 140 and 10% respectively for a profit of Rs. 720. A jeans has cost price that is 20% less than that of the bottle. If the selling price of the jeans is Rs.4680 and it is sold at (x - k)% profit then find the value of k?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling price (SP) of the bottle = 4500 + 720 = Rs. 5220.

Reversing the successive discounts to find MP: MP = (5220 ÷ 0.9) + 140 = Rs. 5940.

Markup percentage (x) = [(5940 − 4500) ÷ 4500] × 100 = 32%.

Cost price of jeans = 20% less than bottle's CP = 4500 × 0.8 = Rs. 3600.

Profit percentage on jeans = [(4680 − 3600) ÷ 3600] × 100 = 30%.

Equating given profit percentage: x − k = 30 ⇒ 32 − k = 30 ⇒ k = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of the bottle = Rs. 4500

Profit earned on the bottle = Rs. 720

Successive discounts on bottle's MP = Rs. 140 and 10%

Selling price (SP) of the jeans = Rs. 4680

CP of the jeans is 20% less than the CP of the bottle

Profit % on jeans = (x − k)%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Selling price (SP) of the bottle = CP + Profit

⇒ SP of the bottle = 4500 + 720 = Rs. 5220

⇒ SP is calculated after two discounts: first Rs. 140, then 10%.

⇒ (MP − 140) × (100 − 10)% = 5220

⇒ (MP − 140) × 0.9 = 5220

⇒ MP − 140 = 5220 ÷ 0.9

⇒ MP − 140 = 5800

⇒ MP of the bottle = 5800 + 140 = Rs. 5940

⇒ Markup % (x) = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

⇒ x = [(5940 − 4500) ÷ 4500] × 100 = (1440 ÷ 4500) × 100 = 32%

⇒ CP of the jeans = 4500 × (100 − 20)% = 4500 × 0.8 = Rs. 3600

⇒ Profit earned on the jeans = SP − CP = 4680 − 3600 = Rs. 1080

⇒ Profit % on the jeans = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % on the jeans = (1080 ÷ 3600) × 100 = 30%

⇒ We are given that the jeans is sold at (x − k)% profit.

⇒ x − k = 30

⇒ 32 − k = 30

⇒ k = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is exclusively given on the Marked Price (MP). Final SP = MP − Discount. For successive discounts, calculate step-by-step or use the successive percentage reduction formula.

Profit & Loss Basics

Profit or loss is always calculated with respect to the Cost Price (CP). Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

Markup Percentage

Markup is the extra amount added to the cost price to determine the marked price. Markup % = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.
